summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group (neither existed), set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and applied 750/640 permissions recursively (owner rwx, group r, others none) while preserving all existing file contents. Verified functionally that a group member can read the data and an unrelated user cannot. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a background-delayed reboot so the ack returned first, polled through the outage, confirmed a new boot_id post-restart, and re-verified ownership/permissions/content hashes were unchanged after recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory contents and initial (insecure, root:root 755/644) ownership/permissions
Captured content hashes and file contents before any change
Created inventorysvc system user and inventory-readers group (neither pre-existed)
chmod 750 on directories, 640 on files recursively
Verified new ownership/permissions and unchanged file hashes
Functionally tested read access: temp user in inventory-readers could read; temp user outside the group was denied read/list
Captured baseline boot_id and permission state on node1
Triggered background-delayed reboot so the exec call acknowledged before disconnect
Polled node1 through the outage until it came back
Confirmed new boot_id (367d272b...) differing from baseline (29011044...), proving an actual restart
Re-verified ownership, permissions, and file content hashes after restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: initial insecure state of /srv/inventory before repair
evidence.summary: Directory/files owned by root:root with 755/644 perms; inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group did not exist

evidence.requirement: Existing content captured before modification (to prove preservation)
evidence.summary: sha256sum and cat of config.json and records.csv recorded pre-change

evidence.requirement: Create inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group
evidence.summary: groupadd inventory-readers and useradd inventorysvc succeeded; id/getent confirm creation

evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, others excluded (750/640)
evidence.summary: chown/chmod applied recursively; stat confirms inventorysvc:inventory-readers 750 on dirs, 640 on files
sha256sum hashes identical before and after the ownership/permission change

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: readers group can read, other users cannot
evidence.summary: sudo -u reader_check (member of inventory-readers) successfully read config.json; sudo -u other_check was denied read and directory listing

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 29011044-5356-46eb-ba9c-1470170355a7 and confirmed /srv/inventory permissions healthy pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot command acknowledged (pid returned) before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just downtime)
evidence.summary: Connection reset/timeout observed during reboot, then node returned with new boot_id 367d272b-ec22-47b6-b545-762f0c660364 and uptime of ~3s, proving a fresh boot distinct from baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart - post-restart recovery of required state (permissions, ownership, data, accounts)
evidence.summary: After restart: ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640), file content hashes identical to baseline, and inventorysvc/inventory-readers accounts still present
